visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a small plush dachshund toy wearing a hoodie, perched atop a takeaway coffee cup in a cafe with warm wooden textures. (2) A small white dog wearing a grey garment jumps up excitedly against a wooden counter. (3) Real dachshunds of different colors (black and tan, cream) walk on a wooden floor near a person's legs. (4) The camera shows a shop counter where multiple orange blind boxes titled 'THE SECRET HOME CONCERT' are displayed; a male hand shows a box inside a plastic bag to a female clerk. (5) A man with short dark hair and a black-and-white striped t-shirt speaks directly to the camera while holding two plush dachshunds, one white and one brown. (6) Shots of various dachshund-themed merchandise including yellow and pink t-shirts with dog illustrations are showcased in a retail environment. (7) The video concludes with the man smiling broadly and gesturing with the plushies in front of a window and later a night-time outdoor background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog for a limited-time group purchase of popular dachshund blind boxes from a Bangkok brand named BENKOFF. It uses high-energy narration, cute animal imagery, and product demonstrations to create a sense of 'fear of missing out' (FOMO) and value for followers.
